brief: The 4 attachment styles explained — and how to heal yours with daily practice.

slots.subtitle: Understand your patterns and heal them with small daily practices that actually last.

slots.body: Attachment styles shape how you love, trust, and handle conflict. They form early, but they are not life sentences. With awareness, you can gently rewrite your patterns.
You crave closeness but fear abandonment. Small shifts in tone can spiral into worry. Your heart is tender; it simply longs for consistency and reassurance.
Independence feels safer than intimacy. When others get close, you quietly retreat. Beneath the armor is a deep need that once felt too risky to name.
You want connection yet brace for hurt at the same time. Love can feel thrilling and frightening. Healing begins in safe relationships where you finally feel seen.
You trust easily and communicate needs without panic. Comfort with closeness lets you give and receive love fully. This is the foundation we can all grow toward.
Notice your triggers with curiosity, not shame. Pause before reacting and ask what you truly need. Small daily choices rewire the way you love over time.
Which style resonated most? Begin with one gentle practice today.
